description: Comment-to-DM and DM automation for Instagram and Facebook, plus influencer campaign management with video tracking on YouTube and TikTok.

pricing.details: Free (100 active contacts, 3 flows, 3 channels, Chat33 branding), no card. Starter 17 €/month (1,000 contacts, 2 team members). Pro 44 €/month (5,000 contacts, 5 members, campaign management). Business 70 €/month (25,000 contacts, 10 members, video tracking). Enterprise 177 €/month (100,000 contacts, dedicated support). Published overage per extra active contact is recorded in the official (non-displayed) notes only, because it is too small to show as whole euros.
